newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SEP increases stake in Orrefors.
newsitem.headline: SEP increases stake in Orrefors.

text.p: Scandinavian Equity Partners Ltd (SEP), part of the three-company consortium involved in buying Swedish glassware company Orrefors Kosta Boda, said it increased its stake in Orrefors to 23.8 percent.

"Scandinavian Equity Partners bought the 23.8 percent stake from (Swedish investment company) Investor AB and immediately sold it to the consortium, OKB (Orrefors Kosta Boda) Holding," Wayne Talloyin, a supervisor at UK financial services company Abacus Ltd, told Reuters.
Abacus adminstrates Scandinavian Equity Partners, which in turn jointly owns OKB Holding along with Swedish investment company Proventus AB and Danish luxury goods maker Royal Copenhagen A/S.
Earlier in the day, OKB Holding announced that it held 97.0 percent of equity and votes in art glass maker Orrefors Kosta Boda. Orrefors Kosta Boda will be delisted from the Stockholm Stock Exchange.
